dct_description_sm: Nitrogen inputs via biological N2-fixation are important in Arctic environments where N often limits plant productivity. An understanding of the direct and indirect theoretical causal relationships between key intercorrelated variables that drive the process of N2-fixation is essential to understanding N input. This project sought to measure biological nitrogen fixation of surface samples to determine the key factors influencing N2-fixation across the Canadian Arctic.
dct_title_s: N2-fixation data Across the Canadian Arctic
